# Every game message, by direction and purpose

From proxy-20261115-134015.jsonl.draining, proxy-20261115-204932.jsonl: 412,070 messages over 8.5 hours on 68 connections. Generated by analysis/message-breakdown.py; names and groups are traffic/protocol.py's. Confidence: confirmed = checked against what the game did; supported = the content or a strict pairing shows it; unnamed = only its group is known (from when it comes).
